name: Taira no Shigehira
source:
He is a survivor of the Taira family. He used to be the enemy of Yorimoto, but now they are alliances because they share the same goal.

Upon first glance he looks fragile. Even though he is described as a peony because of his beautiful look, he has a sharp tongue. He has the personality of not holding back his efforts. He is good at not only music, but also battle.

Organization: Kamakura Bakufu
Interest: Playing instruments (he's very good at it)
